Class AnimationGame

java.lang.Object
app.animation.single.AnimationGame
public class AnimationGame extends Object
Handles various animations for the game, such as card interactions, hover effects, and transitions.

    • cardDragPressed

      public void cardDragPressed(javafx.scene.input.MouseEvent event, javafx.scene.image.ImageView card)
      Handles the initial press action when a card is dragged. Captures the mouse offset relative to the card's position and stores the original position of the card. Slightly reduces the card's opacity and brings it to the front of the display.
      Parameters:
      event - The MouseEvent triggered when the card drag is initiated.
      card - The ImageView representing the card being dragged.

    • cardDragDragged

      public void cardDragDragged(javafx.scene.input.MouseEvent event, javafx.scene.image.ImageView card)
      Handles the action of dragging a card by updating its position relative to the current mouse location. Ensures the card stays within the defined boundaries during the drag action.
      Parameters:
      event - The MouseEvent triggered during the dragging of the card.
      card - The ImageView representing the card being dragged.

    • cardDragReleased

      public javafx.animation.Animation cardDragReleased(javafx.scene.input.MouseEvent event, javafx.scene.image.ImageView card)
      Handles the release action of a card after it has been dragged. Restores the opacity of the card and optionally fades it out if released in a specified delete zone.
      Parameters:
      event - The MouseEvent generated when the card is released after dragging.
      card - The ImageView representing the card that was being dragged.
      Returns:
      An Animation object if the card is to be faded out, or null if no animation is applied.

      Parameters:
      card - The ImageView representing the card.
      cardPlace - The Pane where the card is displayed.

    • getCardAnimation

      public javafx.scene.image.ImageView getCardAnimation(javafx.scene.layout.AnchorPane deckPlace)
      Creates and returns an ImageView representing a card animation. The card's image is set to a card back with specific dimensions, opacity, and position. The card is added to the provided AnchorPane.
      Parameters:
      deckPlace - The AnchorPane where the card animation will be added.
      Returns:
      An ImageView object representing the animated card.

    • getCardTranslateAnimation

      public javafx.animation.Animation getCardTranslateAnimation(javafx.scene.image.ImageView card, int count)
      Creates and returns a translate animation for an ImageView representing a card. The animation moves the card horizontally based on the specified count and vertically to predefined coordinates.
      Parameters:
      card - The ImageView representing the card to be translated.
      count - The index used to determine the horizontal translation distance for the card.
      Returns:
      An Animation object representing the translation movement of the card.

    • putCardTranslateWithPlayerAnimation

      public javafx.animation.Animation putCardTranslateWithPlayerAnimation(javafx.scene.image.ImageView card)
      Animates a card with combined translate and fade-in effects to create a smooth movement and appearance effect, often used for transitioning a card to the player's view.
      Parameters:
      card - The ImageView representing the card to be animated.
      Returns:
      An Animation object combining the translate and fade-in effects.

    • getCardTranslateToPlayersAnimation

      public javafx.animation.Animation getCardTranslateToPlayersAnimation(javafx.scene.image.ImageView card)
      Creates and plays a combined translate and fade-out animation for a card. The card is translated to a specified position and fades out during the transition.
      Parameters:
      card - The ImageView representing the card to be animated.
      Returns:
      An Animation object that combines the translate and fade-out effects.

    • addLeftCardAnimation

      public void addLeftCardAnimation(javafx.scene.control.Label left)
      Adds a scaling animation effect to the specified label. The label briefly scales up and then returns to its original size, creating a visual feedback.
      Parameters:
      left - The Label to which the scaling animation effect is applied.

    • fadeInSinglePlay

      public void fadeInSinglePlay(javafx.scene.layout.Pane pane)
      Plays a fade-in animation effect for all child nodes within the specified pane. Each child node gradually becomes visible as part of a parallel transition.
      Parameters:
      pane - The Pane containing the nodes to apply the fade-in animation.

    • fadeOutSinglePlay

      public void fadeOutSinglePlay(javafx.scene.Scene scene, javafx.scene.layout.Pane pane)
      Plays a fade-out animation for all child nodes within the specified pane and transitions to the main menu view upon the animation's completion.
      Parameters:
      scene - The current Scene where the animation and transition will take place.
      pane - The Pane containing the nodes to which the fade-out animation will be applied.

    • resetFadeOutGame

      public void resetFadeOutGame(javafx.scene.Scene scene, javafx.scene.layout.BorderPane pane, List<Player> players)
      Plays a fade-out animation for all child nodes within the specified BorderPane, and upon completion, either starts a new game or resets the game with the provided players.
      Parameters:
      scene - The current Scene where the animation and game reset will take place.
      pane - The BorderPane containing the nodes to which the fade-out animation will be applied.
      players - The list of players participating in the game. Can be null to start a new game.
